method.clustering: per (subject, class) group; TIER A: exact normalize_skeleton equality (SCIENTIST-literal); TIER B: content-word template key (stopwords dropped, light stem, slot-type tokens kept, sorted); both need >=3 members, >=2 key-parseable; TIER C: singleton clusters -- the bank is authored one-question-per-node and has essentially no same-template numeric clusters (measured), so every numeric-key row is its own held-out fixture
method.lomo: family identified on the train member via the production registry sweep + red-team guards + release gate (autobind lane as fallback); every other eligible member is a held-out recompute trial (Tier C: the row itself)
method.precision: matches / shipped (guard refusals, family non-matches, structure drift and no-numeric results are NOT shipped: coverage losses, never precision hits)
